name: Chaka
what: Garages that rent easy-bikes, battery rickshaws and autos to drivers by the day use it to collect the daily rent and see every driver's arrears.
hard_part: One rule drives everything: a vehicle handed out owes every day until someone writes why it didn't, so arrears are computed, never stored. The ledger exists in JavaScript, Go and Dart, and all three are tested against one golden file generated from a 45-day demo garage.
facts: One SQLite file per garage, so a query cannot cross garages
Every write is an op with a phone-chosen UUID, applied idempotently on sync
19 Flutter tests, 7 against the real Go server
Manager limits enforced by the server, shown on the phone

images.caption: Tonight's rent collection with one-tap amounts per vehicle
Driver page: arrears built day by day
Monthly accounts: collected, off days, expenses, profit
